rule: d bit 1 enables the word-mark test; d bit 2 enables the zone test, comparing the B and A bits of the B-address character against the B and A bits of d. Both bits set = branch on either condition. Always a one-character test; no B-field word mark needed.
simh: SimH implements exactly ((d & 01) && char has WM) || ((d & 02) && (char & 060) == (d & 060)).

rows.condition: B-address character has a word-mark bit
B character has neither a B nor an A bit
B character has both B and A bits (plus test)
B character has a B bit but no A bit (minus test)
B character has an A bit but no B bit

rows.instruction: Branch if WM, or Zone Bits Absent
rows.condition: word mark or no B and no A

rows.instruction: Branch if WM, or Zone Equal AB
rows.condition: word mark or both B and A

rows.instruction: Branch if WM, or Zone Equal B
rows.condition: word mark or B but no A

rows.instruction: Branch if WM, or Zone Equal A
rows.condition: word mark or A but no B
